why_this_was_highest_value: The prior offer page had a visible price and mailto CTA, but the buyer path was still too generic. This run converted it into a structured paid-order intake with required fields, generated order ID, payment-pending proof payload and clearer manual fulfillment path.

regression_checks.expected: 19 EUR appears above the fold and in KPI proof
brand, contact, product, CTA and photo count are required before order email is generated
valid form creates prefilled mailto to automariu@gmail.com with order ID, price, payment-pending status and buyer details
valid form prints JSON order proof with orderId, priceEur, status, buyer, product, photoCount and createdAt
buyer can pay online without manual instructions
regression_checks.blocker: No payment processor or live payment link is available in repo/runtime. Fallback executed: structured paid-order email plus payment-pending order proof.

rejected_weak_patterns: Generic mailto link without required buyer/order fields.
Idea lists, policies, staffing plans or audits counted as progress.
Success claim without order ID, buyer contact, price and payment status.
Waiting for Vitalijus to provide payment setup before improving the purchase path.

kpi_effect.product_state_movement: Offer page moved from simple static CTA to structured order intake with validation, generated order ID and payment-pending proof.
kpi_effect.measurable_next_kpi: First paid order at 19 EUR or first qualified order email with generated order ID.

promoted: Revenue Ops challenger: structured order-intake beats generic contact CTA for buyer-readiness.
demoted: Policy/audit-only agent behavior remains disallowed as proof of revenue progress.

next_executable_task: Create outreach-ready buyer rows and prefilled messages for 20 Lithuanian used-parts/product sellers, each linking to the 19 EUR Quick Product Video offer, then track outreach status in OPS/revenue/leads without waiting for checkout integration.
